xmldoc.short_description: Ask an external AI provider from Nelson.

description.p: aiask calls a configured AI provider such as Ollama or an OpenAI-compatible HTTP endpoint.
For Ollama, aiask uses the local HTTP API endpoint http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/generate by default and sends non-streaming requests.
This function asks the provider directly from Nelson. It does not expose MCP tools. Use mcpserver when an external agent must call Nelson tools.

example_item.example_item_description: Ask a local Ollama model with the default endpoint.
Return both the generated text and the raw Ollama response.
Use the first local Ollama model with a bounded response.
example_item.example_item_data: models = aimodels(); opts = aioptions('Provider', 'ollama', ... 'Model', models{1}, ... 'SystemPrompt', 'Return only Nelson code. Nelson functions use syntax: function y = name(x), statements, end.', ... 'Think', false, ... 'NumPredict', 120, ... 'Temperature', 0); answer = aiask('Write function y = vector_mean(x). Use y = mean(x).', opts)
